reviews.text: I went there today and it was closed at 2:30 PM with no information provided and no one answers the phone.

A very understanding lady, she saw me on the day of my emergency appointment.

Very kind and professional. I just picked up a package that opened at 9:00 AM, and she was there at 8:50 AM. I'm delighted to entrust my dog ​​to someone who loves their job and takes such good care of animals.
I stopped by to pick up some treats for the rabbits I'm fostering, very welcoming and the owner is very friendly!
The staff are very gentle with dogs, attentive to both people and animals, work well and quickly, and know their job well.
Perfect, thank you for your professionalism and kindness. I highly recommend this grooming salon.

I don't usually vent on social media, but seeing the often misleading negative reviews, given without even having been there, I feel compelled to support Aurore, who takes excellent care of both grooming and the well-being of our beloved pets. She's a very good advisor and attentive.
Absolutely recommended, haters be damned!!!

I've been going to this groomer for a long time.
I get my dogs and cats groomed there, and I buy all my pet supplies and food.
Friendly service, quality of care, and expertise.
It's a shame, it's so close to my home, but the lady who works there is extremely unpleasant.

The opening hours show that the store closes at 6 pm, but at 5:45 pm the woman had already closed her gate in front of me… Quite disappointed, as I had rushed home from work to pick up a package of my own before closing time…
I entrusted my Persian cat to them for brushing, grooming, and shampooing, and it went very well, so I'm very satisfied.
Excellent shop, the lady is super nice. <I'm the one who picked up the bird.>
Absolutely unpleasant, unfriendly, and unhelpful. Avoid at all costs. Deserves zero stars.

Doesn't deserve one star. Avoid at all costs. I'm sharing my very disappointing experience with the Cani Star pet shop.

I bought a bird, specifically requesting a lutino cockatiel, 6 months old or younger. During the phone call, the saleswoman assured me the bird came from a reputable supplier, that it had a leg band and a DNA test. I paid a €50 deposit, trusting her.

I also paid a total of €150 for a bird that normally sells for around €100, thinking I was dealing with someone trustworthy.

But then, the delivery dates were constantly pushed back: first one date, then another, with excuses like "it'll arrive at the end of April." I finally agreed to wait.

When I finally received the bird, nothing matched what had been promised: no DNA test, no leg band, and on top of that, its wings were clipped; it couldn't even fly properly. Even the color wasn't what I ordered. I asked for a female, and they gave me a male.

I still had a DNA test done at my own expense, and it confirmed it was a male. When I tried to resolve the issue with the seller, the situation worsened: no proper solution was offered, no refund, and even unfounded accusations.

Later, she told me she was going to resell the bird to someone else on May 26th. Even today, when I called to ask for my money, she insulted me and told me to file a complaint.

The lack of seriousness, respect, and professionalism is total. I strongly advise against going there.

When you walk in, it smells strongly of dog waste. She also eats dog food and says it's so good. She's such a pain. This pet shop is practically empty.

Fantastic, a true professional!
My little Spitz came out looking beautiful 💞. Thank you!
The price was very reasonable! …
A truly effective and gentle groomer, especially with long-haired cats. Saved Lulu from disaster 🐈‍⬛🥇 …

I'm appalled by the comments, appalled by the complete loss of human dignity, especially in Marseille... Between the demand for a refund for a mistreated rabbit that died, and the alleged odors or bad behavior from Aurore...

I've brought my dog ​​in for a full grooming several times, and I'm delighted. Aurore is friendly, funny, professional, and every time I can see that my dog ​​has a great time :) She knows how to put animals at ease 😀 Thank you, and don't read this nonsense!

Dirty grooming salon. My cat came out with an extremely strong smell of product, to the point of being unbearable. In addition, the groomer wasn't gentle with the animals at all.

I strongly advise against this salon. A truly disappointing experience.

I take my cat to the groomer every six months, and he's never experienced anything like this before. Besides, a cat doesn't usually need to be bathed. I didn't understand why he was showered when it wasn't necessary.

The products used had such a strong smell that I doubt they were suitable or natural for cats.

I absolutely do not recommend this establishment.

⚠️ Terrible experience ⚠️
Avoid at all costs! My mother took my Chihuahua to this groomer for a simple nail trim. During the service, the groomer cut my dog's vein. She still charged me €10.

When we got home, my dog ​​was bleeding heavily, crying, and constantly licking his paw, clearly in great pain.

Avoid this person at all costs! This person cut my dog's nails—four on his back paw and another on his other paw, cutting them until they bled. They returned my dog ​​acting as if everything was fine and refuse to reimburse me for the vet bills.

Avoid this and report them!
My two Rottweilers arrive as stray dogs and leave as pampered pets. Thanks again.

You didn't keep anything for me for free, you sold the puppies, you pocketed the money, you're dishonest, you haven't finished paying for Tor and Laika. How much did you pay, ma'am? I have statements proving you sold the puppies, you sold kittens too, and worst of all, Zeus! I'm not going into debt for a dog! See you in court, ma'am!
Dusty, dirty, and disorganized. The store looks like a wreck, or even a zombie! Not to mention the rude and bitter staff.

I'm very surprised by the reviews. I've been taking Elvis to be groomed for 15 years. The service has always been excellent. Elvis is pampered and feels very comfortable with the people who take care of him. The team is professional, very friendly, and caring. The change of ownership hasn't led to any decrease in service at all. I recommend them without hesitation.

The manager and her colleague are incredibly friendly.

The animals are wonderful every time I visit with my children; we spend half an hour admiring the bird cages and other displays.

We ended up buying one, and we always receive a warm welcome when we come to buy seeds. They always offer advice and always check on the animal to see how it's doing and if it's getting along well with the children.

Thank you, Audrey!
Avoid at all costs! Scam, theft, abuse. This is Canistar. Keep your dogs, they will be locked up and never let out. Aurore has a vending machine where the heart should be.
The owner of Canistrar Aurora is very cool; she bought a little dog who is very happy now, and my little dog is Aurora's princess.

I'm stunned by the bad reviews. The owner is lovely and has an unconditional love for animals. I rescued a cat from her that had been abandoned, and she regularly asks for updates. My mother adopted a kitten who is now a very handsome cat. The owner loves her animals and does everything for them. The animals are well cared for and want for nothing. Thank you, madam, for your dedication and your love for our animal friends 🥰

The animals are kept in horrific conditions, their cages are filthy, and there are appalling smells. The temperature inside is very high, which is bad for the animals, and there is no air conditioning. This needs to be reported urgently.
A great find, a friendly and professional manager, very satisfied with my purchase too.

Avoid at all costs!

My usual groomer unfortunately closed down, so I was looking for a new salon for my dog. Without relying on reviews, I decided to form my own opinion by trying Cani Star, the grooming salon closest to my home.

I left my dog ​​there for his first grooming session. My sister went to pick him up. To her great shock, not only did the cut completely disregard the breed standard (Coton de Tuléar), but my dog's ear had been cropped. Yes, cropped.

I've attached the photos I received remotely to this review so you can judge for yourselves the state he was returned to me in.

When I went back to the salon (the next day) to express my dissatisfaction, the only explanation the groomer – who is also the owner of the establishment – ​​could give me was:

"I asked for a very short cut? They said yes." “She also mentioned that my dog ​​had mats, which, according to her, justified the close shave and the resulting injury. Except:

1. My dog ​​has always had some mats (like many long-haired dogs),

2. This never warranted such a short shave, let alone having his fur cut.

I should point out that she is the only person present in this situation with a grooming qualification. She should therefore know that you don't shave a dog so short you can see its skin, especially not a Coton de Tuléar, a breed that requires a minimum of respect for its natural coat.

My veterinarian herself was shocked when she saw the result: according to her, the cut is not only inappropriate but potentially dangerous, as it leaves the skin exposed to the sun. And that's not even mentioning the fact that the ears were shaved—a complete abomination.

But the most serious issue remains this ear injury, which the groomer initially denied.” She even had the nerve to say that the blood we saw was "just dirt." On a dog that had just come from the groomer? 🥲 Luckily, my sister insisted, because it was definitely a cut. It was only after this insistence that the groomer agreed to give me a discount, and then a full refund after my visit the next day. A decision that should have been made immediately, given the state the dog was returned in.

Further proof of the lack of professionalism: some areas were left ungroomed, particularly around the genitals where the hair was still long—even though it's precisely in these areas that you expect a short, neat, and hygienic trim.

In short, there was no care, no respect for the breed, no listening, and above all, no technical skill worthy of a professional groomer. I got the impression that they just swat dogs assembly-line style without any individual consideration.

I'm deliberately refraining from commenting on the living conditions of the animals for sale in this salon, but it speaks volumes about the prevailing attitude towards animals.

I'm sharing photos here to support my claims, and especially photos of the injury, so everyone can form their own opinion.

Finally, to make the comparison clear, I'm also including three photos taken after a grooming session with my former groomer, who knew how to respect my dog's breed and animal welfare. The difference is striking.

For me, it's a definite NO. I strongly advise against this place for anyone who loves and respects their animals.
I love this shop, it's full of great things for animals and the service is excellent.
Always welcoming in the store with a smile

I came to pick up my sister's dog: shaved completely bald, injured ear, a cut disrespectful of its breed. The groomer initially denied the injury, calling it "dirt"... Unacceptable, even with a discount. Avoid at all costs.
